name: web-router-decoy
description: Serves a fake router/device admin login page and reports page views, path probes and every login attempt. Logins always fail.
author: TrueSignal
documentation: Runs unprivileged (UID 65532, no capabilities) on port 8080 inside a bridge-networked container; the Hub publishes host port TS_PORT (e.g. 80) to it. Passwords are reported as an HMAC with the node's capture key by default (TS_PASSWORD_CAPTURE=hash), which still lets the Hub detect honeytoken credentials without storing plaintext; 'plain' reports them in clear. Source IPs are preserved with Docker's default iptables port publishing; with the userland proxy they appear as the Docker gateway.

config.name: TS_PORT
config.description: Host port the decoy appears on

config.name: TS_PASSWORD_CAPTURE
config.description: hash: HMAC with the node capture key; plain: clear text; none: not captured

config.name: TS_PAGEVIEW_WINDOW_SEC
config.description: One page-view event per source per window

config.name: TS_PROBE_COOLDOWN_SEC
config.description: Minimum seconds between path-probe events per source

config.name: TS_LOGIN_COOLDOWN_SEC
config.description: Minimum seconds between login events per source (0 = report every attempt)

triggers.name: web_page_view
triggers.description: First page view of the login portal by a source in the window

triggers.name: web_path_probe
triggers.description: Request for a path that does not exist (scanning, exploit attempts)

triggers.name: web_login_attempt
triggers.description: Login attempt (form or HTTP basic auth)
